verdict.rationale: Xero publishes an official OpenAPI (Swagger) specification repository with OAuth 2.0 security schema, explicitly described as 'official Xero OpenAPI descriptions,' which is directly machine-readable and downloadable from GitHub. This is corroborated by SDK generation (xero-node) built from these specs. Missing for 10: no independent third-party confirmation of spec completeness/versioning or a single canonical spec-file link (vs. repo README only).
